fichas.title: Gas Installation Symbols
fichas.summary: A legend of plan and installation symbols for gas pipes, connections, fittings, shut-off devices, meters, appliances, and exhaust systems. Pipe symbols may indicate nominal diameter; appliance symbols distinguish several gas-heating and cooking devices.
uses: Represent gas pipe routes and connections in technical drawings
Identify gas appliances, fittings, meters, and exhaust components

dimensions.label: Nominal diameter notation
dimensions.context: Example value shown for an exposed horizontal pipe; the symbol specifies nominal diameter.

fichas.title: Gas Appliance Heating Capacities and Gas Volume Flows
fichas.summary: A table compares heating-capacity and gas-volume-flow ranges for gas water heaters, circulating water heaters, storage water heaters, and heating stoves or boilers.

fichas.title: Gas Supply Connections and Meter Arrangements
fichas.summary: Installation drawings show gas supply connections at a building, a cellar meter, meters on each storey, and a gas supply arrangement with a regulator and shut-off components. A separate detail shows a combined water-and-gas house supply compartment.
uses: Route the building gas service and risers
Locate meters, regulators, shut-offs, and appliance branch lines
Coordinate water and gas house-supply connections

dimensions.label: Width of combined water-and-gas compartment
dimensions.context: House supply connection for water and gas in one compartment.

dimensions.label: Depth of combined water-and-gas compartment
dimensions.context: House supply connection for water and gas in one compartment.

fichas.title: Laying Gas Pipes
fichas.summary: Notes and details distinguish freely installed gas lines, pipes laid under plaster, and pipelines in shafts or channels. The text calls for frost-free routing where applicable and ventilation openings for shafts, channels, and suspended ceilings. A buried-pipe detail states that the pipe on undisturbed soil need not be frost-free.
uses: Select gas-pipe routing and installation locations
Ventilate shafts, channels, and suspended-ceiling installations

dimensions.label: Ventilation opening area
dimensions.context: Approximate opening area stated for gas pipelines in shafts or channels.

dimensions.label: Buried-pipe detail dimension
dimensions.context: Dimension printed alongside the gas-pipe trench detail; the OCR reads “≥ 50 / ≥ 2.00” and the exact association of the first value is unclear.

fichas.title: Combustion Air and Heating Room Requirements
fichas.summary: The page gives a minimum-size criterion and combustion-air opening guidance for boiler rooms. For boiler capacities above about 50 kW, it describes an opening cross-section and illustrates a 65 kW example. A separate heating-room detail is marked at approximately 35 kW or greater.
uses: Provide combustion air for gas-heating equipment
Check the stated boiler-room opening guidance
Identify the heating-room capacity category shown

dimensions.context: Minimum size stated in the notes beside the boiler-room diagrams.
